scorecard.rationale: An unofficial Methods transcription identifies sesame oil as a cannabidiol carrier in an uncontrolled dystonia series, with varied drug responses and no oil-only arm. One rat model tested isolated sesamol and catalepsy. Two related Huntington-model reports give motor coordination and memory outcomes with uncertain cohort independence, and no verified dystonia-specific measure. These sources leave toasted sesame oil and Parkinson dystonia open.
